annotations.title: chainpeek: screen a crypto address against the OFAC SDN list

description: chainpeek: screen one crypto address against the US OFAC SDN list's digital currency addresses. For up to 1,000 addresses use check_sanctions_batch; for lookalikes use check_address_poisoning. EVM and bech32 addresses match case-insensitively; base58 BTC, TRX and other formats must match exactly as listed. Screening against the US OFAC SDN digital-currency-address list only (the Treasury SDN list's published crypto addresses), as of the `list_date` in the answer; a non-match does not clear an address; not legal advice or a full compliance check (no other sanctions lists, no clustering, ownership or exposure analysis); verify any match at sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov. Local lookup, typically under 0.1 s (first call up to 1 s). Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/check-crypto-address-sanctions.html

address.description: Crypto address: EVM 0x address, bech32, or a BTC/TRX/other address exactly as listed.
